scope: Preloaded local stage-preview -> confirm -> default chart; excludes HTTP/browser/AI and verification.
resources: 4 DuckDB threads; memory varied only in named memory arms; stats uses existing 2-worker scheduler
storage_scope: Database, WAL and spill logical/allocated bytes after readiness, excluding retained source; not peak disk use.
verification: Exact old full-source typed/schema/statistics fingerprints; verifier runs after clocks/RSS with 1 thread/1GB.
fixtures: Eight complete existing public datasets: tips, penguins, wine, bike, diamonds, bank, retail, taxi.
interpretation: Source staging precedes the changed engine work. Its large run-to-run variation must not be attributed to memory/SQL/compression settings. Compare both whole-path readiness and confirm/preparation phases; three-run medians are measurements on this machine, not universal guarantees.
recommendation: Keep 64MB and automatic compression as defaults. Guarded statistics is the best balanced candidate for a clean production implementation: 5.5% taxi and 8.4% retail preparation gains, low single-digit MiB RSS overhead, unchanged full-file results; tiny controls add 1-4ms. No runtime/default changes made during this experiment.
